title: Photon Count
description: Essential Criteria: The total number of photons must be correctly calculated as approximately 2.5 x 10^87.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The total energy content in photons must be accurately determined as approximately 2.6 x 10^72 ergs.

title: Fermi Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The Fermi momentum of the electrons must be calculated as approximately 2 x 10^-26 g cm/s.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: Key integration steps for calculating the number of photons and energy must be shown and correctly executed.

title: Temperature Dependency
description: Important Criteria: The dependence of photon number and energy on temperature must be correctly identified and applied.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in energy and momentum.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the equations must be avoided.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: Final answers should be clearly presented and labeled with appropriate units.
